description: This file defines API endpoints for managing responses in a FastAPI application, including creating, retrieving, deleting, listing input items, and canceling responses. It supports background polling via Redis and transforms responses between different formats for compatibility with clients like Cursor IDE.

classes.name: ResponsesAPIResponse
classes.description: Data model representing a response object following OpenAI's API format.

classes.name: ResponsePollingHandler
classes.description: Handler for managing polling responses stored in Redis, including creation, retrieval, and cancellation.

methods.name: responses_api
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or stream responses, supporting background polling and response transformation.

methods.name: cursor_chat_completions
methods.description: Handles POST requests from Cursor IDE, transforming Responses API input to chat completion format, supporting streaming.

methods.name: get_response
methods.description: Retrieves a response by ID, supporting both polling cache responses and provider API responses.

methods.name: delete_response
methods.description: Deletes a response by ID, removing it from Redis cache if polling, or passing through to provider API.

methods.name: get_response_input_items
methods.description: Lists input items associated with a response ID.

methods.name: cancel_response
methods.description: Cancels a response by ID, updating status in Redis cache if polling, or passing through to provider API.
